summary.text: Macey Budke is running on the Nebraska Working People Party line in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election for Nebraska's 3rd District. She describes herself as an Independent candidate from North Platte who works in behavioral health management and holds master's degrees in psychology and healthcare administration.

paragraphs.text: Budke says she grew up in rural Nebraska and that her work focuses on helping rural communities access quality care.
The Nebraska Examiner describes her as a registered nonpartisan write-in candidate, while Ballotpedia lists her ballot line as the Nebraska Working People Party.
